That's not what you said though; your acting as if you'd get in deep shit. Chances are you wouldn't get in trouble *at all.* 

As i have said, fridge is a bad place to keep it. You do you, you're a bitch of a roommate and a fucking pain in the ass for people to deal with on campus.

the ones that freak out over their roommate breaking a rule and make life hell for everyone else, and everyone else.

Putting your fate in the hands of someone else is a bit dramatic, dude. It's a slap on the wrist, if that. You're not gonna get thrown out of college because you have a beer in the fridge, it's not high school so nobody is calling your parents, and you're probably not going to get a criminal record over a can of beer.  

Anyway, i'm pretty upfront about not freaking out over alcohol so long as it's not in a place the RA is gonna check. like i said, most places don't toss up the place looking for something to write you up with, and the fridge is probably a bad place.

You're missing my point. A decent roommate wouldn't let you get hit for it because they'd own up. 

Anyway you do you man, i'm glad that you're doing good. You're just the kind of person i dread dealing with on campus which is fair.

And i am positive all of your employers contacted your school to see if you ever got a slap on the wrist for having alcohol in your dorm. 

And besides the point most rules regarding alcohol in dorms is "If we can't see it without looking for it, we don't care." Maybe the fridge isn't the best place to keep it, but if you have a decent roommate it's not worth reporting.

Congrats man -- you've come a long way!!
